The percentage of marks scored by Ravi in Mathematics is:
solution:
**Calculations:**

Total marks in Mathematics = 150

Marks scored by Ravi in Mathematics = 141

Percentage of marks = (Marks scored / Total marks) × 100

Percentage = (141 / 150) × 100 = 94%

**∴ The percentage of marks scored by Ravi in Mathematics is 94%.**
